applicability: Applies to employee salaries, wages, and benefits for work in Oregon (resident and non-resident).

excerpt: Maximum reimbursement for a single film... shall be the total of:... (B) 25 percent of all other actual Oregon expenses.
applicability: Applies to actual Oregon expenses for goods and services.

excerpt: To qualify for reimbursement under this subsection, total actual Oregon expenses for a film or a local media production project must equal or exceed $1 million.

document_title: Oregon Secretary of State Administrative Rules
excerpt: Amounts paid by the production to an individual or company in excess of $1 million are excluded and ineligible for a rebate.
applicability: Applies per individual or company payment.

excerpt: No single qualifying film... can be awarded more than 50% of the entire OPIF fund (net the annual allocations for iOPIF and rOPIF) in any given single fiscal year.
